notes: Modified cash basis, treated as cash. Pages in trimmed PDF: 1 net position, 2-3 activities, 4 governmental funds balance sheet, 5 governmental funds receipts/expenditures (Total Governmental Funds column), 6-7 proprietary net position and revenues/expenses, 8 proprietary cash flows, 9-10-11 budget schedules (General, Special Library, CDBG), 12-13 combining statement of General Fund departments (left and right halves), 14 schedule of proprietary fund departments (Water/Sewer/Trash). General Fund detail now comes from the departments statement (pp12-13, one line per department column, totals tie to 576,182 / 562,711), replacing the p9 budget schedule lines (not recorded, to avoid double counting; departments carry no budget column); the proprietary departments schedule (p14) adds Water/Sewer/Trash detail, with nonoperating lines outside the operating totals. Governmental beginning/ending are fund balances (109,453 / 122,137) = cash basis; all assets are cash/CDs. Transfers net to zero in the total column (General -1,510, CDBG +1,510), so transfers_in/out null; CDBG budget schedule p11 confirms transfers in 1,510. Business-type = Combined System Utilities Fund; measure net position; 337,574 + 344,188 - 285,764 = 395,998. Business-type receipts total is the sum of operating revenues 342,547 + interest 1,641; nonoperating capital outlay and debt payments are recorded as disbursements as printed in the expenses statement (total 285,764 matches activities p2). Proprietary cash flow statement (p8) not recorded in 'proprietary' because basis is cash/modified cash (operating 104,661; capital financing -47,878; investing 0; begin cash 303,477; end 360,260). Budget schedule for General Fund is budgetary basis; its function split (Street 298,142, Housing project 30,890) differs from the fund statement by function but totals 562,711 agree. CDBG schedule has no printed revenue/expenditure totals so no detail_totals for it. Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p4), Total Governmental Funds column. Read pages 1-14 of 14
